description: Machine-readable structural support atoms for the Mars Colony task, consumed by modules/support_accounting.py. Every number cites the DIK element (dik_elements.csv) it is taken from. The model describes infrastructure only; it does not allocate civilians or VIPs.

provenance.floorspace_units_per_structure: SIMULATOR ABSTRACTION: a valid house is credited one 2x2 floorspace unit (conservative lower bound, as in the legacy metrics proxy); actual floor area is not modeled

provenance.soil_units_per_structure: SIMULATOR ABSTRACTION: a valid greenhouse is credited one soil unit (conservative lower bound); soil area is not modeled

provenance.overconnection_policy: EVALUATOR RULE (sources only say a generator supports at most two structures and splits output evenly): physical connections beyond the limit are kept in world state and reported; WHICH endpoints are served is not specified, so none is chosen. The report gives service slots, total water units and serviceable ranges per endpoint category.

validity.validated_structure: project status 'complete', validated_complete true, correct not false
validity.valid_connector: connector project status 'complete', validated_complete true, correct not false; only link entries with both endpoints are graph edges (endpoint-less entries are physical build-step records)
validity.support_vs_validity: construction validity (built to its requirements) and mission support (receives food/water through the network) are separate; support accounting never invalidates a structure
